name: How do I know if my home needs an insulation upgrade?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my home needs an insulation upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs that your home might need an insulation upgrade include consistently high energy bills, uneven temperatures between rooms, drafts, and uncomfortable indoor conditions, especially near exterior walls or the attic. You might also notice your HVAC system running constantly to maintain temperature. During a home energy audit, professionals can assess your current insulation levels and identify areas needing improvement. This is particularly relevant for older homes in areas like Huntington Beach or Orange, which may not meet modern insulation standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for high energy bills, uneven room temperatures, drafts, and constant HVAC operation. A professional energy audit can confirm if an upgrade is needed.
